2026-08-18.content: * **(Cloud Services)** Removed `gcloud beta services mcp enable`, `gcloud beta services mcp disable`, and `gcloud beta services mcp list` as MCP enablement is no longer required and they have been functioning as no-ops.

summary.title: MCP enablement commands removed
summary.summary: The `gcloud beta services mcp enable`, `gcloud beta services mcp disable`, and `gcloud beta services mcp list` commands have been removed. MCP enablement is no longer necessary for these operations, and the commands have been functioning as no-ops.

2026-08-18.content:
* Added `gcloud beta ai semantic-governance-policy-engine deprovision`
  command to tear down a semantic governance policy engine, including its
  tenant project, GKE cluster, and PSC service attachments.
* Promoted `gcloud ai semantic-governance-policies` (`create`, `describe`,
  `update`, `delete`, `list`) and `gcloud ai
  semantic-governance-policy-engine` (`describe`, `update`, `deprovision`)
  commands from beta to GA.

summary.title: AI Governance Policy Engine Now Generally Available
summary.summary: Key commands for managing AI semantic governance policies and policy engines have been promoted to General Availability. This includes commands for creating, describing, updating, deleting, and listing policies, as well as describing, updating, and deprovisioning policy engines. A new command, `gcloud beta ai semantic-governance-policy-engine deprovision`, is also available to facilitate the teardown of policy engine resources.

2026-08-18.content:
* Added fields `precedence` and `condition` to the commands `bq ls
  --reservation_assignment` and `bq show --reservation_assignment` output.
* Added the new `AUTOMATIC_MATERIALIZED_VIEW_REFRESH` job type for users to create reservation assignments with.

summary.title: Reservation assignment updates in BigQuery
summary.summary: We've enhanced reservation assignments in BigQuery by adding `precedence` and `condition` fields to `bq ls` and `bq show` commands. Additionally, a new `AUTOMATIC_MATERIALIZED_VIEW_REFRESH` job type is now available for creating reservation assignments.

2026-08-18.content: * Enabled Enterprise Certificate Proxy (ECP) HTTP Proxy by default for context-aware mTLS requests.

summary.title: Enhanced Certificate Proxy for Secure Access
summary.summary: Enterprise Certificate Proxy (ECP) HTTP Proxy is now enabled by default for context-aware mTLS requests. This update improves the security and efficiency of mutual TLS authentication processes.

2026-08-18.content: * Rebuilt cbt cli with newer version of bigtable client for CVE-2026-39883.

summary.title: Bigtable CLI Updated
summary.summary: The Cloud Bigtable CLI has been rebuilt with an updated client library to address CVE-2026-39883. This update ensures enhanced security for your Bigtable interactions. We recommend updating to the latest version.

2026-08-18.content:
* Updated `gcloud iam workforce-pools create-cred-config` and `gcloud iam workforce-pools create-login-config` to accept short-format provider audiences (`<pool>/<provider>`).
* Added `gcloud beta iam workforce-pools providers create-saml` and `gcloud beta iam workforce-pools providers update-saml` commands.

summary.title: Workforce Pool IAM Updates
summary.summary: New commands are available for creating and updating SAML providers within workforce pools. Additionally, commands for creating credential and login configurations now support short-format provider audiences for easier management.

2026-08-18.content:
* **API Keys**: Added `--append` flag to `gcloud services api-keys update`
  command to merge new application and API target restrictions with existing
  key restrictions instead of replacing them.

summary.title: Update API key restrictions
summary.summary: The gcloud services api-keys update command now supports an --append flag. This allows you to merge new restrictions with existing ones instead of overwriting them entirely.

2026-08-18.content:
* Fixed `gcloud cluster-director clusters create` to not create default compute resources when they are overridden by the user.
* Updated `gcloud cluster-director clusters create` to default to `hyperdisk-balanced` boot disks and restrict persistent disks (PD) for non-N2 and non-CT5P machine types.
* Fixed a validation error during cluster updates that concurrently modified storage resources and Slurm node sets.

summary.title: Cluster Director Improvements
summary.summary: This update addresses issues with cluster creation and updates, including fixes for default resource creation and storage validation. It also refines boot disk defaults for improved performance and compatibility.

2026-08-18.content:
* Added `gcloud compute target-ssl-proxies test-iam-permissions` command to test IAM permissions on a Compute Engine target SSL proxy in `beta`, `preview`, and `GA`.
* Added `--max-stream-duration` flag to `gcloud compute backend-services create` and `update` commands in beta, preview, and GA.
* Added `gcloud compute packet-mirrorings test-iam-permissions` command for beta, preview and GA tracks.

summary.title: New Compute Engine Features
summary.summary: Compute Engine now supports testing IAM permissions for target SSL proxies and packet mirrorings. Additionally, a new flag for managing stream duration in backend services has been introduced.

2026-08-18.content:
* Fixed issue where `gcloud` CLI would crash on corrupted `~/.kube/config`.
  Now you will now get a more detailed explanation about which section and line
  is wrong, to make troubleshooting easier. Corrupted kubeconfig will be backed
  up for further troubleshooting.

summary.title: CLI crash fixed
summary.summary: The gcloud CLI no longer crashes when encountering a corrupted kubeconfig file. The corrupted file will be backed up, and more detailed error information will be provided to aid in troubleshooting.

2026-08-18.content:
* Added `--reserved-public-ip` and `--reserved-public-ip-nat-ips-count` flags to `gcloud database-migration private-connections create`.
* Added `--fetch-reserved-public-ips` flag to `gcloud database-migration connection-profiles fetch-static-ips`.

summary.title: New options for private connectivity
summary.summary: Enhance your private connectivity configurations with new flags for creating private connections and fetching reserved public IP addresses. These additions offer greater control over your network setup during database migrations.

2026-08-18.content: * Add `--enable-slice-controller` flag in `gcloud container clusters create` and `gcloud container clusters update`.

summary.title: Slice Controller Enabled for Clusters
summary.summary: Kubernetes Engine now supports the slice controller. Enable it during cluster creation or update using the `--enable-slice-controller` flag in gcloud commands.

2026-08-18.content:
* Added `--total-vm-storage-size-gb` flag to
  `gcloud oracle-database cloud-exadata-infrastructures configure-exascale`
  and `--properties-vm-backup-storage-type`,
  `--properties-vm-file-system-storage-type` flags to
  `gcloud oracle-database cloud-vm-clusters create` to support Exascale VM
  storage options.

Subscribe to these release notes at <https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce>.

summary.title: Oracle Database Exascale Storage Options
summary.summary: New flags have been added to gcloud oracle-database commands to support Exascale VM storage options. These updates include `--total-vm-storage-size-gb` for infrastructure configuration and `--properties-vm-backup-storage-type` and `--properties-vm-file-system-storage-type` for VM cluster creation. This enhances the flexibility for managing storage in Exascale environments.
